__comment: One gate leaf. Drawn ONCE per leaf and stretched to the leaf's size, so keep it simple: anything fussy in here gets smeared across the whole leaf. Depth is the point, detail is not. UVs below are ignored at render time -- the renderer projects the gate's own texture across this geometry -- so you only need to worry about shape.

elements.__comment: The leaf itself: a 4px slab centred on the gate plane.
